policy.decision_use: Only evaluated rules backed by observed values and explicit limits may create alerts. Experimental model outputs may rank or explain but may not force escalation.
policy.validation_minimum: A model is not validated until its outcome definition, sample window, calibration/discrimination metrics, limitations, reviewer, and versioned result are recorded.
policy.review_frequency: quarterly, and after every material methodology or data change

models.label: Attention composite
limitations: severity, exposure and concentration include curated inputs
score is not loss, probability, utilisation or capital

models.label: Evaluated breach rules
limitations: only the currently configured score, movement, confidence and deadline rules are evaluated

models.label: Monte Carlo loss proxy
limitations: not portfolio-position based
rating volatility fallback where no market history exists
not a regulatory VaR model

models.label: Joint stress proxy
limitations: not an EVT model
Gaussian dependence proxy
some correlations and volatilities are fallbacks

models.label: Dependency-network exposure
limitations: commodity dependency graph is not a contractual supplier network
edge weights may be estimates

models.label: 30-day pressure index
limitations: not a probability
coefficients have not been fitted to realised outcomes
may not trigger escalation

models.label: Model range and disagreement
limitations: component families share inputs and are not independent
no score floor or automatic action is permitted

models.label: Local portfolio CFaR
limitations: normal variance-covariance approximation
uses only factors with available monthly volatility
correlation gaps default to zero
input remains in the browser

models.label: Ind AS 109 relationship diagnostics
limitations: does not apply an 80-125 bright line
does not replace documented judgement
credit risk and hedge-ratio assessment require user evidence
